{{Top|leg}}
'''Chiss commandos''' were a special forces unit employed within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. They saw action during the [[Battle of Tenupe]] the final battle of [[Swarm War]]. Chiss commandos wore camouflaged color-shifting, [[fractal-pattern armor]] that allowed them to sneak across battlefields with ease, and carried [[demolition satchel]]s and [[Charric/Legends|charric]] guns. They were deployed on specialist tasks such as the placement of [[vape charge]]s on selected locations.
